item.title: Art reflects State’s culture: CM Sidda
item.description: Bengaluru: Chief Minister Siddaramaiah on Sunday said that art serves as a mirror of the state’s culture and that Chitra Santhe has provided an important platform for artists and art lovers alike. He was speaking after inaugurating the 23rd edition of Chitra Santhe, organised by the Karnataka Chitrakala Parishath at its premises on Kumarakrupa Road in Bengaluru. item.title: Man stabs 30-yr-old woman to death
item.description: Karwar: Authorities discovered Rafiq Yallur dead in a forest near Yallapur town on Sunday, apparently by suicide, just one day after he allegedly murdered 30-year-old Ranjita Bansode. The attack occurred on Saturday afternoon in Kalammanagara locality. Rafiq reportedly slashed Ranjita’s throat with a knife after she rejected him, then escaped the area.
